Record Class JsonTaskData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.owltask.task.msgs.JsonTaskData
All Implemented Interfaces:
IJsonData
public record JsonTaskData(String taskId, String name, String description, String status, String priority, String dueTime, String creationTime, String comments, String projectId, String projectName, String milestoneId, String milestoneName, String createdBy, List<String> assignees, List<JsonTaskCommentData> commentHistory) extends Record implements IJsonData
Wire representation of a Task (UC-06, UC-07, UC-03). All temporal/UUID fields are plain Strings (ISO-8601 / UUID.toString()) so this record serializes with a plain Gson instance, no custom type adapters needed.

assignees is populated by TaskQueryService (batch-loaded from AssignmentRepository) for listTasks/getTaskDetails; TaskWriteService's create-response leaves it empty since assignment happens as a separate step right after creation.

projectName/milestoneName let views (e.g. "My Tasks", Task Details) show human-readable names without a separate lookup per task.

commentHistory is parsed from the taskComments column.
